Sell · April Johnson

Sell your house in Columbus, GA with a clear plan

Before you list, you want to know what your property could sell for, what needs attention and how the sale fits your next move. You may be weighing repairs against cost or wondering whether to sell before buying again.

I help homeowners in Columbus, Phenix City and surrounding communities work through pricing, marketing and negotiations.

Request a seller consultation ↗

Start with the property and your priorities

Tell me why you are considering a sale, when you would like to move and what concerns you most. Share the property's address, condition and updates so we can have a useful conversation about the next steps.

If pricing is your first question, request a home-value review.

Decide what to address before listing

Preparation with a purpose

Before committing to a long improvement list, let's discuss the property and the presentation you want buyers to see. My interest in interior design and staging informs the way I help sellers think about preparing their homes.

Marketing that explains the property

A marketing plan should communicate the property's features clearly. We can discuss how to present the layout, condition and other relevant details, as part of the listing plan we agree on.

Discuss your property's pricing and preparation ↗

Understand the offer before making the decision

When an offer arrives, you need to understand the proposed price, terms and timing. I provide guidance through negotiations and the selling process so you can ask questions before deciding how to respond.

Keep the next move in view

If you also need to buy, tell me early. Visit buyer representation to see how we can discuss both parts of the move. If your sale is connected to military orders, explore PCS relocation support.

Tell me about the home you are considering selling

Start with the address and your intended timeframe. You can also tell me what you are unsure about, including preparation, pricing or coordinating a purchase.

Have a question about your own situation?

Ask April ↗
How much can I sell my Columbus, GA house for?

I need to review the property before discussing a suggested price. Send its address, condition and recent updates through the home-value request form.

What should I fix before selling my home?

Bring your repair and improvement list to a seller consultation. We can discuss your priorities before you commit to work. No specific repair return is promised.

How long will it take to sell my home?

I cannot give you a reliable timeline without reviewing your property and current conditions. Tell me your target move date so we can discuss it when planning the sale.

What does April include in her listing services?

My work includes guidance on pricing, marketing strategies, negotiations and the selling process. We will discuss the specific marketing services and representation terms for your property.

Can April help me sell a property in Phenix City?

Yes. I work with sellers in Phenix City as well as Columbus and other areas in my Alabama and Georgia service markets.

Let’s start with you

What would you like to do next?

Buying, selling, or working out how to do both. Bring your questions.
